title: Improving Semantic Segmentation via Video Propagation and Label Relaxation
mechanism: Boundary label relaxation: at boundary pixels maximise the summed probability of all classes in a small window, so small misplacements are not punished.
adaptation: Within a 3x3 window of crack label pixels the target is crack OR neighbour class (log of summed probabilities); elsewhere standard CE; tolerates 1 px jitter without widening the target.
min_experiment: Arm: relaxed CE on crack, 5 seeds; baseline SUP100. Kill: crack IoU < +0.012 at equal relP@2.
evidence: R: Cityscapes 83.5 mIoU, robustness to boundary annotation noise and propagation artefacts.
prior_overlap: Partial: offset-tolerant CE (P14) at 10% labels used a min over shifts and was n.d.; summed-probability relaxation at 100% labels is untested.
